verdict.rationale: Maritime documents cron triggers that take a standard five-field expression, wake the agent on schedule, and deliver a prompt on every fire. Agents can also set their own schedules in natural language, which the platform syncs into real wake triggers. The docs further position the platform as a home for migrated cron jobs and scheduled functions. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that scheduled triggers fire reliably; all evidence is vendor docs.
